26    /**
27     * Store the cover image from a file, URL, or base64 string.
28     *
29     * @param \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile|string $coverSource
30     * @param string $bookId
31     * @return string|null
32     */
33    private function storeCoverImage($coverSource, string $bookId): ?string
34    {
35        if ($coverSource instanceof \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile) {
36            return $coverSource->store($bookId, 'covers');
37        }
38
39        if (filter_var($coverSource, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL)) {
40            return $this->importCoverImageFromUrl($coverSource, $bookId);
41        }
42
43        if (is_string($coverSource) && Str::startsWith($coverSource, 'data:image')) {
44            $extension = Str::after(Str::before($coverSource, ';'), 'data:image/');
45            $data = base64_decode(Str::after($coverSource, ','));
46            $path = $bookId . '/cover.' . $extension;
47            Storage::disk('covers')->put($path, $data);
48
49            Log::debug('BookController@storeCoverImage: Method completed', ['path' => $path]);
50            return $path;
51        }
52
53        return null;
54    }

81    /**
82     * AJAX: Resync title, author, and series from a directory path.
83     * POST /admin/books/resync-from-path
84     *
85     * @return \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
86     */
87    public function resyncFromPath(Request $request)
88    {
89        $request->validate([
90            'directoryPath' => 'required|string',
91        ]);
92        $directoryPath = $request->input('directoryPath');
93        try {
94            $parser = new \App\Services\BookDirectoryParser();
95            $absPath = $parser->resolveStoragePath($directoryPath);
96            if (!is_dir($absPath)) {
97                return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Directory does not exist . '], 404);
98            }
99            $parsed = $parser->parseDirectory($absPath);
100            $book = is_array($parsed) && count($parsed) > 0 ? $parsed[0] : null;
101            if (!$book) {
102                return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Could not parse directory . ']);
103            }
104            // Normalize output for JS
105            $authors = [];
106            if (!empty($book['author'])) {
107                $authors = is_array($book['author']) ? $book['author'] : [$book['author']];
108            }
109            $series = [];
110            if (!empty($book['series']) && is_array($book['series'])) {
111                foreach ($book['series'] as $name => $number) {
112                    $series[] = ['name' => $name, 'number' => $number];
113                }
114            } elseif (!empty($book['series'])) {
115                $series[] = ['name' => $book['series'], 'number' => $book['seriesNumber'] ?? ''];
116            }
117
118            return response()->json([
119                'success' => true,
120                'title' => $book['title'] ?? '',
121                'authors' => $authors,
122                'series' => $series,
123            ]);
124        } catch (\Exception $e) {
125            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()], 500);
126        }
127    }

218                    $sort = 'series';
219                    $order = 'asc';
220                    break;
221                case 'series_desc':
222                    $sort = 'series';
223                    $order = 'desc';
224                    break;

226                    $sort = 'series_number';
227                    $order = 'asc';
228                    break;
229                case 'series_number_desc':

256            // Get paginated and filtered books from the document store service

383        }

385        [$coverAuto, $coverCandidates] = $this->findCoverImageCandidate($directoryPath);
386        // If no cover and no images, try m4b extraction
387        if (empty($coverAuto) && empty($coverCandidates)) {
388            $dir = rtrim($this->storagePath, '/') . '/' . ltrim($directoryPath, '/');
389            if (is_dir($dir)) {
390                $m4bs = array_values(array_filter(scandir($dir), function ($f) use ($dir) {
391                    return is_file($dir . '/' . $f) && strtolower(pathinfo($f, PATHINFO_EXTENSION)) === 'm4b';
392                }));
393                if ($m4bs) {
394                    $firstM4b = $dir . '/' . $m4bs[0];
395                    $coverFile = $this->extractCoverFromM4B($firstM4b, $dir);
396                    if ($coverFile) {
397                        $coverAuto = $coverFile;
398                    }
399                    $tags = $this->extractTagData($firstM4b);
400
401                    // Map ID3 tags to book fields: artist = author, composer = narrator, date = published_date
402                    if (!empty($tags['artist']) && empty($initial['author'])) {
403                        $initial['author'] = [$tags['artist']];
404                    }
405
406                    if (!empty($tags['composer']) && empty($initial['narrator'])) {
407                        $initial['narrator'] = $tags['composer'];
408                    }
409
410                    if (!empty($tags['date']) && empty($initial['release_date'])) {
411                        // Use the date directly if it's a valid date format
412                        if (preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $tags['date'])) {
413                            $initial['release_date'] = $tags['date'];
414                        } else {
415                            // Extract year and create a date (e.g., "2025" -> "2025-01-01")
416                            $year = substr($tags['date'], 0, 4);
417                            if (is_numeric($year) && $year >= 1000 && $year <= date('Y')) {
418                                $initial['release_date'] = $year . '-01-01';
419                            }
420                        }
421                    }
422
423                    if (!empty($tags['description'])) {
424                        $initial['description'] = $tags['description'];
425                    }
426                }
427                // Also check metadata.abs for description and year
428                $meta = $this->extractMetadataAbs($dir);
429                if (!empty($meta['description']) && empty($initial['description'])) {
430                    $initial['description'] = $meta['description'];
431                }
432                if (!empty($meta['year']) && empty($initial['release_date'])) {
433                    // Convert year to date format
434                    if (is_numeric($meta['year']) && $meta['year'] >= 1000 && $meta['year'] <= date('Y')) {
435                        $initial['release_date'] = $meta['year'] . '-01-01';
436                    }
437                }
438            }
439        }
440        if ($directoryPath) {
441            try {
442                if (Storage::disk('books')->exists($directoryPath)) {
443                    $files = Storage::disk('books')->files($directoryPath);
444                    foreach ($files as $file) {
445                        if (preg_match('/\.(jpe?g|png|gif|svg)$/i', $file)) {
446                            $candidate = basename($file);
447                            $coverCandidates[] = $candidate;
448                            $size = Storage::disk('books')->size($file);
449                            if ($size > $biggestSize) {
450                                $biggestSize = $size;
451                                $biggestCover = $candidate;
452                            }
453                        }
454                    }
455                }
456            } catch (\League\Flysystem\UnableToCreateDirectory $e) {
457                $bookStoragePath = config('filesystems.disks.books.root');
458                throw new \RuntimeException(
459                    "Book storage directory is not accessible. The configured path '{$bookStoragePath}' does not exist or cannot be created. " .
460                    "Please check that the BOOK_STORAGE_PATH environment variable points to a valid, accessible directory."
461                );
462            }
463        }
464        // Always fetch genreList as array for the form
465        // Normalize genreList to flat array of strings
466        $genreListRaw = $documentStore->listGenres();
467        $genreList = [];
468        foreach ($genreListRaw as $g) {
469            if (is_array($g) && isset($g['name'])) {
470                $genreList[] = (string) $g['name'];
471            } elseif (is_string($g)) {
472                $genreList[] = $g;
473            }
474        }
475
476        // If in import mode, ensure the requested genre exists in the genre list
477        if ($isImportMode) {
478            $requestedGenres = $request->get('genre', []);
479            if (!is_array($requestedGenres)) {
480                $requestedGenres = [$requestedGenres];
481            }
482
483            foreach ($requestedGenres as $requestedGenre) {
484                if (!empty($requestedGenre) && !in_array($requestedGenre, $genreList)) {
485                    // Add the new genre to the list so it appears in the dropdown
486                    $genreList[] = $requestedGenre;
487
488                    // Also add it to the database for future use
489                    try {
490                        $documentStore->createGenre(['name' => $requestedGenre]);
491                        Log::info('Auto-created genre during import', ['genre' => $requestedGenre]);
492                    } catch (\Exception $e) {
493                        Log::warning('Failed to auto-create genre', [
494                            'genre' => $requestedGenre,
495                            'error' => $e->getMessage(),
496                        ]);
497                    }
498                }
499            }
500        }
501
502        // Debug logging for genre list
503        Log::debug('Genre list for form', [
504            'genreList' => $genreList,
505            'requested_genre' => $isImportMode ? ($request->get('genre') ?? 'none') : 'not_import'
506        ]);
507        // Guarantee initial['author'] and initial['genre'] are arrays for JS and Blade
508        if (empty($initial['author']) || !is_array($initial['author'])) {
509            $initial['author'] = [''];
510        }
511        if (empty($initial['genre']) || !is_array($initial['genre'])) {
512            $initial['genre'] = [''];
513        }
514        $book = []; // Initialize empty book array
515
516        if (!isset($initial['directoryPath'])) {
517            $initial['directoryPath'] = '';
518        }
519
520        // Normalize selected genres for the form
521        $genres = [];
522        if (!empty($initial['genre'])) {
523            foreach ($initial['genre'] as $g) {
524                $genres[] = trim((string) $g);
525            }
526        }
527        // Also allow old input to override
528        $genres = old('genre', $genres);
529        if (!is_array($genres)) {
530            $genres = [$genres];
531        }
532
533        if ($request->ajax()) {
534            return view(
535                'admin.books.create_form',
536                compact(
537                    'genreList',
538                    'genres',
539                    'initial',
540                    'coverCandidates',
541                    'coverAuto',
542                    'biggestCover',
543                    'directoryPath'
544                )
545            )
546                ->with('isModal', true)
547                ->with('layout', 'layouts.modal');
548        }
549
550        // Ensure initial['author'] is a string for the form field if it's an array
551        if (isset($initial['author']) && is_array($initial['author'])) {
552            $initial['author'] = array_map(function ($a) {
553                return is_array($a) ? implode(', ', $a) : (string) $a;
554            }, $initial['author']);
555        }
556
557        return view(
558            'admin.books.create_form',
559            compact(
560                'genreList',
561                'genres',
562                'initial',
563                'coverCandidates',
564                'coverAuto',
565                'biggestCover',
566                'directoryPath'
567            )
568        );
569    }

586    /**
587     * Process the import of a book from file/audio.
588     *
589     * @param Request $request
590     * @return \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse|\
591     */
592    public function processImport(Request $request)
593    {
594        Log::info('Book import processing started', ['request_data' => $request->except(['cover', 'coverImage'])]);
595
596        try {
597            Log::debug('BookController@processImport: starting validation', ['input_keys' => array_keys($request->all())]);
598            // Validate the request data
599            $validated = $request->validate([
600                'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
601                'author' => 'required|array',
602                'author.*' => 'required|string|max:255',
603                'genre' => 'required|array',
604                'genre.*' => 'required|string|max:255',
605                'narrator' => 'nullable|array',
606                'narrator.*' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
607                'series' => 'nullable|array',
608                'series.*.seriesName' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
609                'series.*.name' => 'nullable|string|max:255', // For backward compatibility
610                // Accept numeric or string for series number (tests may send int)
611                'series.*.number' => 'nullable|max:50',
612                'import_path' => 'nullable|string',
613                'import_root' => 'nullable|string',
614                'import_type' => 'nullable|string',
615                'cover_url' => 'nullable|url',
616                'description' => 'nullable|string',
617                'year' => 'nullable|string|max:4',
618                'publisher' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
619                'isbn' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
620                'language' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
621                'pages' => 'nullable|integer',
622                'rating' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:5',
623            ]);
624
625            $id = (string) Str::uuid();
626            $validated['id'] = $id;
627
628            // Handle empty arrays
629            if (empty($validated['author'])) {
630                $validated['author'] = ['Unknown'];
631            }
632            if (empty($validated['genre'])) {
633                $validated['genre'] = ['Uncategorized'];
634            }
635
636            // Handle cover image from URL if provided
637            if (!empty($validated['cover_url'])) {
638                Log::debug('Processing cover image from URL', ['url' => $validated['cover_url']]);
639                try {
640                    $coverPath = $this->importCoverImageFromUrl($validated['cover_url']);
641                    if ($coverPath) {
642                        $validated['cover'] = $coverPath;
643                        Log::debug('Cover image imported successfully', ['path' => $coverPath]);
644                    }
645                } catch (\Exception $e) {
646                    Log::warning('Failed to import cover image from URL', [
647                        'url' => $validated['cover_url'],
648                        'error' => $e->getMessage(),
649                    ]);
650                }
651                // Remove the cover_url from validated data as it's not stored in the document
652                unset($validated['cover_url']);
653            }
654
655            // Handle series
656            if (!empty($validated['series'])) {
657                $seriesLinks = [];
658                foreach ($validated['series'] as $seriesData) {
659                    // Use null coalescing to handle both 'seriesName' and legacy 'name'
660                    $seriesName = $seriesData['seriesName'] ?? $seriesData['name'] ?? null;
661
662                    if ($seriesName) {
663                        $seriesDoc = $this->documentStoreService->getSeriesByName($seriesName);
664                        $seriesId = $seriesDoc['id'] ?? $this->documentStoreService->createSeries($seriesName);
665
666                        $seriesLinks[] = [
667                            'id' => $seriesId,
668                            'name' => $seriesName,
669                            'number' => $seriesData['number'] ?? null
670                        ];
671                    }
672                }
673                $validated['series'] = $seriesLinks;
674            }
675
676            // Add import metadata if available
677            $importPath = null;
678            $importRoot = null;
679            $importType = null;
680            $genrePath = null;
681            $directoryPath = null;
682
683            if (!empty($validated['import_path']) && !empty($validated['import_root'])) {
684                $importPath = $validated['import_path'];
685                $importRoot = $validated['import_root'];
686                $importType = $validated['import_type'] ?? 'dir';
687
688                if (isset($validated['genre_path'])) {
689                    $genrePath = $validated['genre_path'];
690                } elseif (!empty($validated['genre']) && is_array($validated['genre'])) {
691                    $genrePath = $validated['genre'][0];
692                } else {
693                    $genrePath = 'Other';
694                }
695
696                if (is_string($genrePath) && $genrePath !== '') {
697                    session(['import_default_genre_path' => $genrePath]);
698                }
699
700                $directoryPath = $this->buildDirectoryPath($validated);
701
702                $validated['import_metadata'] = [
703                    'path' => $importPath,
704                    'root' => $importRoot,
705                    'type' => $importType,
706                    'imported_at' => now()->toISOString(),
707                    'genre_path' => $genrePath,
708                    'directory_path' => $directoryPath,
709                ];
710
711                // Remove these fields as they're not stored directly in the document
712                unset($validated['import_path'], $validated['import_root'], $validated['import_type'], $validated['genre_path']);
713            }
714
715            // Resolve and attach IDs for authors, narrators, and genres
716            try {
717                if (!empty($validated['author'])) {
718                    $validated['authors'] = $this->documentStoreService->findOrCreateMany('authors', $validated['author']);
719                }
720                if (!empty($validated['narrator']) && is_array($validated['narrator'])) {
721                    $validated['narrators'] = $this->documentStoreService->findOrCreateMany('narrators', $validated['narrator']);
722                }
723                if (!empty($validated['genre'])) {
724                    $validated['genres'] = $this->documentStoreService->findOrCreateMany('genres', $validated['genre']);
725                }
726            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
727                Log::warning('BookController@processImport: findOrCreateMany failed', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
728            }
729
730            // Create the book in the document store and capture returned ID
731            Log::debug('BookController@processImport: calling createBook', [
732                'service_class' => get_class($this->documentStoreService),
733                'keys' => array_keys($validated),
734            ]);
735            $createdId = $this->documentStoreService->createBook($validated);
736            Log::debug('createBook returned ID', ['createdId' => $createdId, 'originalId' => $id]);
737            if (!empty($createdId)) {
738                $id = (string) $createdId;
739                $validated['id'] = $id; // Update the validated data with the actual ID
740            }
741            Log::info('Book imported successfully', ['finalId' => $id]);
742
743            // If we have import path information, attempt to move the files to the library
744            if ($importPath && $importRoot && $directoryPath) {
745                try {
746                    // Use the ImportFileController to move the files
747                    $importFileController = app()->make('App\Http\Controllers\Admin\ImportFileController');
748
749                    $moveRequest = new Request([
750                        'path' => $importPath,
751                        'root' => $importRoot,
752                        'genrePath' => $genrePath,
753                        'directoryPath' => $directoryPath,
754                        'type' => $importType,
755                    ]);
756
757                    Log::info('Attempting to move imported files to library', [
758                        'path' => $importPath,
759                        'root' => $importRoot,
760                        'genrePath' => $genrePath,
761                        'directoryPath' => $directoryPath,
762                        'type' => $importType,
763                    ]);
764
765                    $moveResult = $importFileController->moveSelected($moveRequest);
766                    $moveData = json_decode($moveResult->getContent(), true);
767
768                    if (isset($moveData['success']) && $moveData['success']) {
769                        Log::info('Successfully moved imported files to library', [
770                            'newPath' => $moveData['newPath'] ?? 'Unknown'
771                        ]);
772                    } else {
773                        Log::warning('Failed to move imported files to library', [
774                            'message' => $moveData['message'] ?? 'Unknown error',
775                            'details' => $moveData['details'] ?? ''
776                        ]);
777                    }
778                } catch (\Exception $moveException) {
779                    Log::error('Exception while moving imported files to library', [
780                        'error' => $moveException->getMessage(),
781                        'trace' => $moveException->getTraceAsString(),
782                    ]);
783                    // Don't throw the exception - we still want to return the book import success
784                }
785            }
786
787            // Fire the NewBookAdded event using the created ID
788            $bookData = ['id' => $id, 'title' => $validated['title']];
789            Log::debug('Dispatching NewBookAdded event', ['bookData' => $bookData]);
790            event(new NewBookAdded($bookData));
791            Log::debug('NewBookAdded event dispatched');
792
793            // Return redirect response for both AJAX and regular requests (relative path for tests)
794            return redirect('/admin/books/' . $id . '/edit')
795                ->with('success', 'Book imported successfully.');
796        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $ve) {
797            Log::error('BookController@processImport: validation failed', [
798                'errors' => $ve->errors(),
799                'input' => $request->all(),
800            ]);
801            return back()->withErrors($ve->validator)->withInput();
802        } catch (\Exception $e) {
803            Log::error('Book import failed', ['error' => $e->getMessage(), 'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString()]);
804
805            return back()->withErrors(['error' => 'Import failed: ' . $e->getMessage()])->withInput();
806        }
807    }

809    /**
810     * Build a directory path from book metadata
811     *
812     * @param array $bookData Book metadata
813     * @return string Formatted directory path
814     */
815    private function buildDirectoryPath(array $bookData): string
816    {
817        $parts = [];
818
819        // Use the first genre as the genre path if not explicitly provided
820        if (isset($bookData['genre_path'])) {
821            $genrePath = $bookData['genre_path'];
822        } elseif (!empty($bookData['genre']) && is_array($bookData['genre'])) {
823            $genrePath = $bookData['genre'][0];
824        } else {
825            $genrePath = 'Other';
826        }
827        $parts[] = $genrePath;
828
829        // Add author (use first author if multiple)
830        if (!empty($bookData['author'])) {
831            $parts[] = is_array($bookData['author']) ? $bookData['author'][0] : $bookData['author'];
832        }
833
834        // Add series if available
835        if (!empty($bookData['series'])) {
836            $series = $bookData['series'][0] ?? null;
837            if (is_array($series) && !empty($series['seriesName'])) {
838                $parts[] = $series['seriesName'];
839            } elseif (is_string($series)) {
840                $parts[] = $series;
841            }
842        }
843
844        // Add title
845        if (!empty($bookData['title'])) {

1778    {

1781

1785
1786        // Get book details for validation

1796            }

1798                ->with('error', 'Book not found');
1799        }
1800
1801        $directoryPath = $bookData['directoryPath'] ?? null;
1802        $bookId = $book;
1803
1804        // Check if directory is shared and files are to be deleted
1805        if ($deleteFiles && !$confirmed && !empty($directoryPath)) {
1806            $isShared = $deletionService->isDirectoryShared($bookId, $directoryPath);
1807
1808            if ($isShared) {

1810                return redirect()->back()
1811                    ->with('error', 'This book shares a directory with other books. You can only delete the database record.')
1812                    ->with('requires_confirmation', true)
1813                    ->with('book_id', $bookId)
1814                    ->with('book_title', $bookData['title'] ?? 'Unknown')
1815                    ->with('shared_directory', $directoryPath)
1816                    ->with('return_url', $returnUrl);
1817            }
1818        }
1819
1820        // If directory is shared and confirmed, force deleteFiles to false
1821        if (!empty($directoryPath)) {
1822            $isShared = $deletionService->isDirectoryShared($bookId, $directoryPath);
1823            if ($isShared && $deleteFiles) {
1824                Log::info('Forcing database-only deletion for shared directory', [
1825                    'book_id' => $bookId,
1826                    'directory_path' => $directoryPath,
1827                ]);
1828                $deleteFiles = false;
1829            }
1830        }
1831
1832        $result = $deletionService->moveToTrash($book, $deleteFiles);
1833
1834        if ($result['success']) {
1835            $message = $deleteFiles ? 'Book and files moved to trash successfully.' : 'Book deleted from database (files preserved).';
1836
1837            if ($returnUrl) {
1838                return redirect($returnUrl)
1839                    ->with('success', $message)
1840                    ->with('trash_item_id', $result['trash_item_id']);
1841            }
1842
1843            $queryParams = $request->query();
1844            if (empty($queryParams)) {
1845                return redirect()->route('admin.books.index')
1846                    ->with('success', $message)
1847                    ->with('trash_item_id', $result['trash_item_id']);
1848            }
1849            return redirect()->route('admin.books.index', $queryParams)
1850                ->with('success', $message)
1851                ->with('trash_item_id', $result['trash_item_id']);
1852        }
1853
1854        if ($returnUrl) {
1855            return redirect($returnUrl)
1856                ->with('error', 'Failed to delete book: ' . ($result['error'] ?? 'Unknown error'));
1857        }
1858
1859        $queryParams = $request->query();
1860        if (empty($queryParams)) {
1861            return redirect()->route('admin.books.index')
1862                ->with('error', 'Failed to delete book: ' . ($result['error'] ?? 'Unknown error'));
1863        }
1864        return redirect()->route('admin.books.index', $queryParams)
1865            ->with('error', 'Failed to delete book: ' . ($result['error'] ?? 'Unknown error'));

1868    public function download($id)
1869    {
1870        $documentStore = $this->documentStoreService;
1871        $book = $documentStore->getBook($id);
1872        $directoryPath = $book['directoryPath'];
1873
1874        try {
1875            if (!$directoryPath || !Storage::disk('books')->exists($directoryPath)) {
1876                abort(404, 'Book directory not found.');
1877            }
1878
1879            $files = Storage::disk('books')->files($directoryPath);
1880        } catch (\League\Flysystem\UnableToCreateDirectory $e) {
1881            $bookStoragePath = config('filesystems.disks.books.root');
1882            throw new \RuntimeException(
1883                "Book storage directory is not accessible. The configured path '{$bookStoragePath}' does not exist or cannot be created. " .
1884                "Please check that the BOOK_STORAGE_PATH environment variable points to a valid, accessible directory."
1885            );
1886        }
1887
1888        if (empty($files)) {
1889            abort(404, 'No files found for this book.');
1890        }
1891
1892        $zipFileName = str_replace(' ', '_', $book['title']) . '.zip';  // Sanitize filename
1893        $zipPath = storage_path(
1894            'app/public/temp/' . $zipFileName
1895        );  // Temporary storage
1896
1897        $zip = new ZipArchive();
1898
1899        if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
1900            abort(500, 'Failed to create zip archive.');
1901        }
1902
1903        foreach ($files as $file) {
1904            $zip->addFile(Storage::disk('books')->path($file), basename($file));
1905        }
1906
1907        $zip->close();
1908
1909        // Return the zip file as a download
1910        return response()
1911            ->download($zipPath, $zipFileName)
1912            ->deleteFileAfterSend(true); // Delete the temp zip file after sending.
1913    }

2420    public function checkDirectoryConflict(Request $request)

2435
2436        try {

2438            $results = $this->documentStoreService->listBooks(

2448            $conflictingBooks = [];
2449            if (!empty($results['books'])) {

2452                    if ($currentBookId && $book['id'] === $currentBookId) {

2459                    }
2460                    $conflictingBooks[] = [
2461                        'id' => $book['id'],
2462                        'title' => $book['title'] ?? 'Unknown',
2463                        'author' => $authorDisplay,
2464                    ];
2465                }
2466            }

2468            if (empty($conflictingBooks)) {
2469                return response()->json([
2470                    'conflict' => false,
2471                ]);
2472            }
2473
2474            return response()->json([
2475                'conflict' => true,
2476                'books' => $conflictingBooks,
2477                'count' => count($conflictingBooks),
2478            ]);
2479        } catch (\Exception $e) {

2481            return response()->json([

2483                'error' => 'Failed to check for conflicts',

2488    /**
2489     * Build directory path from form fields (genre, author, series, title)
2490     */
2491    public function buildPathFromFields(Request $request)

2501        $parts = [];

2503        // Build path in order: genre/author/series/{seriesNumber title}
2504        // Note: seriesNumber and title are combined in the final segment
2505        if (!empty($validated['genre'])) {
2506            $parts[] = preg_replace('/[\\/]/', '-', trim($validated['genre']));

2509            $parts[] = preg_replace('/[\\/]/', '-', trim($validated['author']));

2515        // Combine seriesNumber and title into final segment
2516        $finalSegment = [];
2517        if (!empty($validated['seriesNumber'])) {

2519            $seriesNum = trim($validated['seriesNumber']);
2520            if (is_numeric($seriesNum)) {

2522            }
2523            $finalSegment[] = $seriesNum;
2524        }
2525        if (!empty($validated['title'])) {

2527        }
2528        if (!empty($finalSegment)) {
2529            $combined = implode(' ', $finalSegment);
2530            $parts[] = preg_replace('/[\\/]/', '-', $combined);
2531        }
2532
2533        if (empty($parts)) {

2535                'success' => false,
2536                'message' => 'At least one field must be provided to build a path',
2537            ], 400);
2538        }
2539
2540        $directoryPath = implode(DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $parts);
2541
2542        return response()->json([
2543            'success' => true,
2544            'directoryPath' => $directoryPath,
2545        ]);
2546    }

2620            return response()->json([

2728     */
2729    public function saveRawJson($id, Request $request)
2730    {

2734        }

2739        }

2741        unset($data['_id']);
2742        $data['id'] = $id;

2745        if (!$book) {

2747        }
2748        $documentStore->updateBook($id, $data);
2749        return response()->json(['success' => true]);

2752    /**
2753     * Extract embedded cover from audio files in the book directory
2754     */
2755    public function extractEmbeddedCover(Request $request)
2756    {
2757        $directoryPath = $request->input('directory_path');
2758
2759        if (!$directoryPath) {
2760            return response()->json(['error' => 'Directory path is required'], 400);
2761        }
2762
2763        // Get the full path to the book directory
2764        $bookRoot = rtrim(config('app.book_root', '/media/lyra_data1/audiobooks/books'), '/');
2765        $fullDirectoryPath = $bookRoot . '/' . ltrim($directoryPath, '/');
2766
2767        if (!is_dir($fullDirectoryPath)) {
2768            return response()->json(['error' => 'Directory not found: ' . $directoryPath], 404);
2769        }
2770
2771        // Initialize getID3
2772        if (!class_exists('\getID3')) {
2773            return response()->json(['error' => 'getID3 library not available'], 500);
2774        }
2775
2776        $getID3 = new \getID3();
2777        $getID3->option_tag_id3v1 = false;
2778        $getID3->option_tag_id3v2 = false;
2779        $getID3->option_tag_lyrics3 = false;
2780        $getID3->option_tags_process = true; // Enable tag processing to get embedded covers
2781
2782        // Find audio files in the directory
2783        $audioFiles = glob($fullDirectoryPath . '/*.{mp3,m4a,m4b,m4p,mp4,aac,ogg,oga,wav,flac,wma}', GLOB_BRACE);
2784
2785        if (empty($audioFiles)) {
2786            return response()->json(['error' => 'No audio files found in directory'], 404);
2787        }
2788
2789        $extractedCovers = [];
2790
2791        foreach ($audioFiles as $audioFile) {
2792            try {
2793                $info = $getID3->analyze($audioFile);
2794
2795                // Check for embedded cover in various formats
2796                $coverData = null;
2797                $mimeType = 'image/jpeg';
2798
2799                // Check QuickTime/M4B tags
2800                if (!empty($info['comments']['picture'][0])) {
2801                    $coverData = $info['comments']['picture'][0]['data'];
2802                    if (!empty($info['comments']['picture'][0]['image_mime'])) {
2803                        $mimeType = $info['comments']['picture'][0]['image_mime'];
2804                    }
2805                }
2806
2807                // Check ID3v2 tags (MP3)
2808                if (!$coverData && !empty($info['id3v2']['APIC'])) {
2809                    foreach ($info['id3v2']['APIC'] as $pic) {
2810                        if ($pic['picturetypeid'] === 3 || $pic['picturetypeid'] === 0) { // Cover(3) or Other(0)
2811                            $coverData = $pic['data'];
2812                            if (!empty($pic['mime'])) {
2813                                $mimeType = $pic['mime'];
2814                            }
2815                            break;
2816                        }
2817                    }
2818                }
2819
2820                // Check ASF/WMV tags
2821                if (!$coverData && !empty($info['asf']['comments']['picture'])) {
2822                    foreach ($info['asf']['comments']['picture'] as $pic) {
2823                        if (!empty($pic['data'])) {
2824                            $coverData = $pic['data'];
2825                            if (!empty($pic['image_mime'])) {
2826                                $mimeType = $pic['image_mime'];
2827                            }
2828                            break;
2829                        }
2830                    }
2831                }
2832
2833                // Check OGG Vorbis tags
2834                if (!$coverData && !empty($info['ogg']['comments']['coverart'][0])) {
2835                    $coverData = base64_decode($info['ogg']['comments']['coverart'][0]);
2836                    // OGG doesn't always store mime type, default to jpeg
2837                }
2838
2839                if ($coverData) {
2840                    // Create temporary file for the cover
2841                    $extension = $this->getExtensionFromMimeType($mimeType);
2842                    $tempFile = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'embedded_cover_') . '.' . $extension;
2843
2844                    if (file_put_contents($tempFile, $coverData)) {
2845                        $extractedCovers[] = [
2846                            'file' => basename($audioFile),
2847                            'temp_path' => $tempFile,
2848                            'mime_type' => $mimeType,
2849                            'size' => strlen($coverData),
2850                            'url' => 'data:' . $mimeType . ';base64,' . base64_encode($coverData)
2851                        ];
2852                    }
2853                }
2854            } catch (\Exception $e) {
2855                Log::warning('Failed to extract cover from audio file', [
2856                    'file' => basename($audioFile),
2857                    'error' => $e->getMessage()
2858                ]);
2859            }
2860        }
2861
2862        if (empty($extractedCovers)) {
2863            return response()->json(['error' => 'No embedded covers found in audio files'], 404);
2864        }
2865
2866        return response()->json([
2867            'success' => true,
2868            'covers' => $extractedCovers,
2869            'message' => 'Found ' . count($extractedCovers) . ' embedded cover(s)'
2870        ]);
2871    }

2879            'image/jpeg' => 'jpg',
